findings.title: checkout.session.async_payment_failed is unhandled — a failed delayed payment leaves the row pending with no audit, notification, or terminal transition
findings.evidence: _ -> wisp.json_response("{}", 200)  // unknown-event arm; router handles only completed | async_payment_succeeded | expired
findings.detail: The new state machine settles PendingPayment via async_payment_succeeded but has no arm for its documented failure twin checkout.session.async_payment_failed. It hits the silent unknown arm: unclaimed, unlogged, no fail_payment, no audit, no notification. checkout.session.expired cannot fire for an already-completed session, so the row is stuck pending forever. Reachable for pre-deploy in-flight async sessions the idempotency-tag bump itself acknowledges exist.
findings.recommended_fix: Route checkout.session.async_payment_failed through handle_checkout_failed (fail_payment + audit + notification) in the same router case block.

findings.title: 100%-off promo redemption completes with payment_status="no_payment_required" — the gate strands the order permanently: no settle, fail, or expired event ever follows
findings.detail: Sessions set allow_promotion_codes=true, and the code's own contract documents 100% promos ('ZERO is a valid settled amount... amount_total: 0'). Stripe fires completed with payment_status no_payment_required for $0 sessions; per the Stripe API enum (paid/unpaid/no_payment_required) nothing async follows. Gate claims the event, row stuck pending forever, vacancy locked forever, info log only. Pre-deploy this order completed at amount_cents=0 and unlocked — a real behavior regression on a legitimate promo path (not transitional: card-only does not prevent $0 sessions).
findings.recommended_fix: Treat payment_status no_payment_required with amount_total==0 as terminal success (unlock), or stop allowing promotion codes; minimally document that 100% codes must never be created.

findings.title: Settle path depends on an out-of-band Stripe Dashboard event subscription not in the repo's checklist
findings.evidence: ## Stripe Dashboard checklist (out-of-band, manual) ... **Webhooks → Endpoint** points at the Cloud Run service URL with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET matching the Dashboard signing secret.
findings.detail: The pending path settles only if the Dashboard endpoint subscribes checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded. Unsubscribed, pre-deploy in-flight async sessions stay pending forever — landlord charged, vacancy never unlocks. The checklist documents exactly this class of dependency (consent ToS URL entry) but was not extended.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a checklist bullet: webhook endpoint event selection must include checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded.

findings.title: arm parameter threads through claim/logs but not the in-tx MalformedMetadata reason strings — async settle failures get mislabeled 'checkout.session.completed' reasons
findings.evidence: Error(MalformedMetadata("checkout.session.completed metadata.sku_type " <> meta <> ...)) — reached from both arms
findings.detail: run_completed_side_effects is reached from both arms, but its three MalformedMetadata reasons hardcode 'checkout.session.completed'. An async_payment_succeeded event failing metadata validation logs '(checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded) rolled back: checkout.session.completed invalid vacancy_id…' — contradictory labels during a payment incident.
findings.recommended_fix: Thread arm into run_completed_side_effects and prefix the three MalformedMetadata reason strings with it.

findings.title: Structurally missing payment_status is silently consumed: acked 200, claimed, logged at info only
findings.evidence: wisp.log_info("Stripe event " <> event_id <> ... <> " not 'paid' — vacancy stays locked...")
findings.detail: Fail-closed is correct and tested, but a malformed/shape-changed Stripe payload that drops payment_status on real paid sessions would strand every such landlord behind an info-level log — no warning, no Sentry event, no retry. The consent-absent branch fires a Sentry background event for a comparable anomaly.
findings.recommended_fix: Emit a Sentry background event (warning level) when payment_status is structurally missing rather than merely non-paid.

findings.title: "processing" is not a valid Checkout Session payment_status — the fixture pins an input Stripe never sends (session enum is paid/unpaid/no_payment_required)
findings.evidence: Stripe API reference: payment_status (enum) — one of paid, unpaid, or no_payment_required. 'processing' exists only on PaymentIntent.
findings.detail: Session-level payment_status never equals 'processing'; delayed methods complete with 'unpaid'. The processing test exercises an impossible input — harmless for the gate (all non-paid values take one branch, and unpaid+missing cover reality) but the handler's doc comments repeat the 'processing' claim. Worth renaming the fixture/comment to 'unpaid-method-in-flight' fidelity.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep the test (belt-and-braces) but correct the webhook_handler doc comments: delayed methods arrive 'unpaid', not 'processing'.

findings.title: Extension SKU never boundary-tested through the M-1 gate — all non-paid fixtures hardcode sku_type 'vacancy_unlock'
findings.evidence: build_event_body_full(..., "vacancy_unlock", 29_900, payment_status) — fixed SKU in all pending fixtures
findings.detail: The shared gate also guards the VacancyExtension arm (gate runs before run_completed_side_effects SKU routing), but no non-paid extension fixture exists, so a SKU-specific gate regression would pass unnoticed.
findings.recommended_fix: Parametrise run_pending_completed_assertions over sku_type and add one extension-SKU pending case.

findings.title: New checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded arm only exercised with payment_status='paid' — its PendingPayment branch untested directly
findings.detail: The arm's non-paid branch is shared with the completed arm and transitively covered, but no fixture drives async_payment_succeeded with a non-paid status, so an arm-specific gate regression would go uncaught.
findings.recommended_fix: Add one async_payment_succeeded + non-paid fixture asserting the PendingPayment path.
